Daily Devotional

September 30

10 As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one: (Romans 3:10 KJV)

This is quoting Old Testament scripture (Psalms 14:1-3 & 15:1-3), and is how God sees all who have not been born again. In our human righteousness we are like filthy rags in the eyes of a Holy God (Isaiah 64:6). Our human righteousness is what determines how we are viewed in this world, and how we relate to others in this world, but no matter how good we think we are, our righteousness is far below what God requires in order to fellowship with Him.

Thank you Jesus for coming and dying for us, and giving us your righteousness (2 Corinthians 5:21) so that God will see us as righteous as you are. Jesus did for us what we could not do for ourselves, as there is no way a human can be good enough to be accepted by God on a human level. We must be born again (John 3:3), and imparted with the righteousness of Jesus to be Holy enough to approach the Throne of God. Jesus did so much more for us then just save us from going to hell, but the church tends to focus on that one thing. He brought us not only salvation, but also where we can approach God directly, as well as healing our bodies, prosperity and deliverance from the devil. Thank you Jesus for all you have done for us believers.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
